task: Draft a fact-sheet section for a fictional public-health programme describing which age groups are invited to participate in a routine screening initiative. Do not add eligibility exclusions, referral instructions, or clinical outcomes not supplied.

facts.text: The fictional programme is the Westfield Community Screening Initiative.
The initiative invites adults aged 45 to 70 to participate.
Participants are notified of their results within six weeks of attending.
The programme fact sheet does not specify clinical eligibility exclusions.

forbidden_additions: Clinical eligibility exclusions not in the facts.
A referral pathway or follow-up care description.
A diagnostic outcome or detection-rate claim.
